result.description:
Job Description – Practice Nurse
Job title: Practice Nurse	Reports to: Head Nurse 
                        Chief Executive Officer
Purpose of position
To ensure smooth and efficient functioning of the practice and provide an exceptional standard of care to our patients.

Responsibilities 

Clinical
•	Perform clinical duties within required level of clinical competency, according to best available evidence.  Explain procedures to patients, providing them with support and reassurance.  Duties include triage, immunisations and other injections; wound management, chronic disease management, ECG’s and collection of pathology samples.  Assist doctors with clinical procedures.  Maintain clinical documentation.
•	Oversee cold chain process, awareness, responsibilities and documentation of cold chain process.
•	Monitor infection control standards and implement changes / educate.

Patient Services
•	Assist with triage, data management, diagnostic services, networking with other providers, planning & management of patient care and patient advocacy.  Telephone patients with test results as directed by medical staff.  

Improvement of Patient Health Outcomes
•	Conduct preventative/screening procedures; assist with patient education and community health promotion activities.  Co-ordinate patient recall and outreach programs and GP management plans and team care arrangement.  

Equipment and Supplies
•	Maintain stocks of clinical supplies, including correct storage (such as refrigeration), removal of out-of-date stock and ordering supplies.  Provide input in purchasing relevant clinical equipment and supplies.
•	Assist with stock ordering bi – monthly
•	Assist with monthly vaccine order
•	Complete daily job allocation sheet
•	Check emergency trolley daily
•	Check O2 therapy as per job description
•	Monitor cold chain process twice daily

Compliance
•	Maintain awareness of current and new legislation to ensure business is complying with all statutory and regulatory obligations including infection control, sterilisation, hazardous materials & safe handling/disposal of medical waste, records management, OHS, and accreditation.  Ensure relevant personnel are kept informed and changes are made to systems and procedures as required.  

Professional
•	Act within the practice and nursing code of ethics & appropriate level of clinical competence at all times.  Maintain awareness of current evidence and research on clinical practices and inform/educate other practice staff. Change systems and procedures to ensure compliance with best available evidence as applicable.  

OHS
•	Consistently be aware of OHS requirements and comply with them.

General
Delegation of tasks to other medical and non-medical staff. 
Assist with other practice duties as required.  

Expected behaviours and personal attributes 
•	Demonstrate a knowledge of and compliance with all relevant legislation and common law obligations affecting nursing.
•	Discharge of duty of care in the course of practice including meeting practice standards, and accountability for nursing actions.
•	Demonstrate knowledge of policies and procedural guidelines that have legal implications, for example, ensure documentation conforms to legal requirements.
•	Practice only within the limits of their educational preparation and competence.
•	Identify and respond to unsafe practice, for example, implement interventions to prevent unsafe practice and/or contravention of law.
•	Demonstrated patient-focused approach in service provision with genuine empathy and interest in their needs.
•	Excellent interpersonal and communication skills across all ages and social groups.
•	Be always well presented, friendly, courteous and obliging.  Represent the practice in a confident and positive manner at all times. 
•	Undertake all duties in a diligent manner, with honesty and integrity, 
•	Maintain absolute confidentiality regarding patient and practice information.
•	Have a vigilant attitude to accuracy, being prepared to double check as necessary.
•	Ability to work cooperatively and independently. & ability to prioritise and organise, with attention to detail.
•	Demonstrated commitment to ongoing professional development
•	This position requires physical ability to occasionally lift and/or move patients.
•	Possession of current driver’s licence (include only if essential to perform job, such as home visits)

Education, Qualifications and Experience  
Essential:
•	Appropriate tertiary qualification & registration certificate. 
•	Professional indemnity cover.
•	Minimum of one year of nursing experience, preferably in a community-based role.
•	Demonstrated understanding of the needs of general practice and interest in community-based nursing including patient education and health promotion.
•	Knowledge of current immunisation schedules, Diabetes management, asthma management, enhanced primary care items, infection control, CPR and emergency resuscitation techniques, equipment & drugs.

Desirable:
•	Competence in the use of relevant equipment & software – be specific, give brand-names if appropriate. 
•	Experience in similar role as practice nurse or community-based nursing.
•	Experience with specific social groups serviced by practice, such as adolescents, aged care, migrant or refuge groups, aboriginals & Torres Straight islanders, etc.
•	Additional qualifications such as Accredited Women’s Health Certificate, Diabetes Education Certificate, Asthma/Spirometry qualification/education.
•	Member of APNA.

Hours Of Work
As per fortnightly roster 
Weekend & Public Holiday work as rostered   
However it is expected that our staff will work extra time on occasions if this is required to deliver essential patient care.
Breaks:  30 minutes for lunch and 10 minutes each for morning and afternoon tea to be taken in shifts with other staff to ensure continuity of care. 

Other features: 
 
Professional development provided or expected.
Requirement for use of own vehicle, if essential to the position.
Potential for contact with hazardous material such as blood & body fluids.
May be required to have some immunisations.

A well-established medical centre located west of the Blue Mountains, is seeking a GP to join their team, covering for one of the female doctors currently on maternity leave. With a collaborative environment and a focus on patient care, this practice offers a supportive workplace for both experienced GPs and doctors working towards Fellowship. 

  About the Practice  
The team consists of five GPs, two nurses, and administrative staff who work together to provide high-quality healthcare. The clinic operates under a mixed billing model, giving doctors the opportunity to build strong patient relationships while achieving excellent earnings. Depending on prior GP experience in Australia, billing percentages typically range from 65% to 70%. 

  Support and Mentorship  
The principal GP offers on-site mentoring, providing valuable guidance for doctors working towards their Fellowship (FSP). The practice is also open to candidates beginning on the PFP program while waiting for their FSP term to commence. 

  Modern Facilities and Community Roots  
The clinic operates from a state-of-the-art building, offering ample secure parking, disabled access, and two fully equipped treatment rooms. With over 60 years of service, the practice has built a strong relationship with the local community and continues to collaborate closely with a nearby pharmacy to meet patient needs.

Our client is an award-winning, privately-owned medical and allied health clinic located in the heart of Melbourne’s CBD. Since its establishment in 2008, this clinic has grown to offer a wide range of services, providing patients with the convenience of addressing all their healthcare needs in one location. 

 The clinic is staffed by an experienced team of general practitioners and allied health professionals, including physiotherapists, podiatrists, psychologists, and occupational health specialists. 

 Are you a GP with a passion for men’s or women’s health, skin lesion management, or occupational health? Or perhaps you have a specific area of interest you'd like to develop further? This opportunity offers the perfect platform to grow your career in a thriving, supportive environment. 

  Why You’ll Love This Role:  

 
	  Private Billing Practice : Enjoy great income potential in a fully private billing setting. 
	  Professional Growth : Opportunity to focus on and develop a specific area of interest. 
	  Supportive Management : Work with an experienced team known for running successful practices. 
	  Comprehensive Care : Be part of an integrated approach to healthcare with allied health and pathology support. 
	  Flexible Options : Full-time and part-time roles available with flexible working hours. 
	  State-of-the-Art Facilities : Newly fitted, generously sized consulting rooms in a modern, fully accredited clinic. 
	  Convenient Location : Growing practice in Melbourne CBD, easily accessible via trams and trains. 
	  Nursing Support : Onsite nursing support to enhance patient care. 
	  Immediate Start : Begin making a difference right away! 
 

  Role Highlights:  

 
	 Modern, state-of-the-art facility 
	 High earning potential 
	 Take over an existing patient base 
	 Fully private billing 
	 Negotiable percentage of billings based on experience

Where there's life, there's Mercy. 

Where there's care, there's You.

Through the battles and the breakthroughs, we're there. Where will you be?

For over a century, our incredible teams have provided care for people when they need it most. Our people feel great pride in this, and they value the security and stability we offer. But it also means so much opportunity - to build on all that's gone before, to grow your impact and gain experience that's hard to find elsewhere.

As a for-purpose organisation with over 10,000 dedicated, compassionate people, we continue to offer more services and deeper care than ever before. With Mercy, you'll have the chance to make an impact and gain experience that's hard to find elsewhere.

At Mercy Health, it's all about taking what we have and making it better. 

To do that, we need you. 

Join us at Mercy Health, and help our teams deliver even greater outcomes. 

About the opportunity

Our Birthing Suite midwives are highly skilled, and passionate about providing evidenced based, women centred care.

Work a rotating roster including Morning, Afternoon & Night duty shifts, with the opportunity to upskill and work 0930-1800 triaging induction bookings and performing cervical ripening for induction of labour. Should you prefer to work only night duty shifts, this will also be considered. 

We support our midwives to grow and develop their skills to be able to provide hollistic care in birthing services.

What you'll bring

You're resilient, compassionate and have a whole lot of heart. Most importantly, you are committed to delivering exceptional patient-centred care.

To thrive in this role, you will have:

Previous birthing suite experience

Level 2 or above RANZCOG practitioner status

Competence to perform IV Cannulation, Balloon Catheter insertion for induction of labour, perineal suturing, and waterbirth (or working towards these skills)

Knowledge of managing high risk, complicated pregnancies and birth, but also possess the skills and desire to facilitate physiological birth where possible

About you: 

You are approachable, compassionate and contribute to a positive team culture. 

Excellent clinical, time management, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to adapt and problem solve.

You are compassionate and demonstrate a flexible and positive approach to effective patient care

You will also be required to provide evidence of, or in the process of obtaining:

A current Police Record Check and Working with Children Check.

Proof of current influenza vaccination and other vaccination status consistent with public health orders.

AHPRA Registration

Ready to help us shape the future of healthcare?

Join us and make a meaningful difference in people's lives - and your career.

General Practitioner (VR GP) | Permanent | Fully Bulk Billing  

  Location: South-East of Perth CBD, WA  

   

  ABOUT THE PRATICE  

 Our client is a well-established, highly respected general practice located south-east of Perth CBD. Known for its warm, community-focused approach and long-term staff retention, the practice boasts a team of 6 GPs who have all been with the clinic for over a decade—with one senior doctor serving the local community for 24 years. 

 Due to continuous patient demand and a newly dedicated consulting room becoming available, the practice is seeking a full-time General Practitioner to join their stable and supportive clinical team. 

   

  ABOUT THE ROLE  

  Position Type:  Permanent 

  Hours & Weekend Work:  Standard weekday roster. Saturday morning coverage is available on a rotating basis if preferred. 

  Flexible Roster:  While Saturday morning availability is welcomed on a rotating roster 

  Competitive Financial Support  - 70% of billings (based on commitment to the practice), backed by an initial hourly guarantee of $180 - $200/hr for the first 3 months 

  Billing Structure  - Fully Bulk Billing practice (participating in the BBPIP incentive program) 

  Nursing Support -  Dedicated clinical assitance provided by 1 FT registered nurse, 1PT registered nurse, and a FT enrolled nurse. 

  Modern Practice Software:  Best Practice software utilized throughout, with AI-assisted documentation tools (Lyrebird AI) integrated to streamline clinical notes and administrative workload. 

   

  ABOUT YOU  

  Registration:  Vocational Registration (VR GP) with AHPRA (FRACGP, FACRRM, or equivalent). 

  Experience:  Strong clinical background with a passion for delivering patient-centered care within a collaborative team environment. 

  Commitment:  Looking for a supportive long-term practice environment with fantastic peer retention. 

   

 If you are looking for a cohesive team with exceptional doctor longevity and full nursing support, we would love to hear from you. 

 For a confidential discussion or to submit your CV, please apply directly or contact us today. 

     Apply Now
